study.title: Creatine supplementation in older adults: a randomized controlled trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Creatine is thought to raise muscle strength in older adults.
METHODS: Sixty adults aged 65 to 80 took creatine or placebo for 12 weeks.
RESULTS: The one-repetition maximum for leg press rose by 12 kg with creatine and 4 kg with placebo (p = 0.01).
CONCLUSIONS: Creatine improved leg press performance.

study.title: Protein timing in frail adults: a randomised trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Muscle strength declines with age.
METHODS: 80 frail adults were randomised.
RESULTS: Handgrip force rose by 2.1 kg versus placebo.
CONCLUSIONS: Protein timing helped.

study.title: Vitamin D and knee extensors in older women
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Vitamin D may support strength.
METHODS: Isokinetic dynamometry at 60 deg/s.
RESULTS: Knee extensor peak torque did not differ.
CONCLUSIONS: No benefit.

study.title: Cinnamon in type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Cinnamon is said to lower blood sugar.
METHODS: 100 adults.
RESULTS: HbA1c fell by 0.2 percentage points.
CONCLUSIONS: Small effect.

study.title: Vinegar in adults with type 2 disease: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Vinegar is said to lower blood sugar.
METHODS: 60 adults took vinegar or water.
RESULTS: A1C fell by 0.3% with vinegar and by 0.1% with water.
CONCLUSIONS: Small effect.

study.title: Berberine in adults with prediabetes
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) and blood sugar are raised in prediabetes.
METHODS: 90 adults took berberine or placebo.
RESULTS: FPG fell by 0.4 mmol/L.
CONCLUSIONS: Berberine lowered FPG.

study.title: Ginger and metabolic markers: a randomized trial
study.abstract:

METHODS: 70 adults.
RESULTS: HOMA-IR fell by 0.8.

study.title: Oat beta-glucan in adults: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Oats are said to lower cholesterol.
METHODS: 120 adults.

study.title: Plant sterols and atherogenic particles
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Plant sterols lower cholesterol.
METHODS: 80 adults.
RESULTS: Apolipoprotein B fell by 6%.
CONCLUSIONS: Fewer atherogenic particles.

study.title: Magnesium in older adults: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Poor sleep quality, measured with the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), is common in older adults.
METHODS: 46 adults took magnesium or placebo.
RESULTS: PSQI global score fell by 2 points.
CONCLUSIONS: Magnesium helped.

study.title: Melatonin in adults with delayed phase
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Melatonin is used for insomnia.
METHODS: 40 adults.
RESULTS: Participants fell asleep 9 minutes earlier and woke less often.
CONCLUSIONS: Melatonin helped.

study.title: Online CBT in adults: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Insomnia is common.
METHODS: 300 adults.
RESULTS: ISI scores fell by 6 points.
CONCLUSIONS: CBT helped.

study.title: Green tea extract in adults: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Green tea is said to help weight loss.
METHODS: 100 adults.
RESULTS: Waist circumference fell by 2 cm; participants lost 1.1 kg.

study.title: Intermittent fasting versus daily restriction: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Weight loss is the main aim of dieting.
METHODS: 140 adults.
RESULTS: Participants lost 4.2 kg with fasting and 4.0 kg with restriction.
CONCLUSIONS: No difference.

study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Mortality in intensive care is high.
METHODS: 475 adults.
RESULTS: 118 patients in the vitamin D group and 125 in the placebo group died within 90 days.
CONCLUSIONS: No benefit.

study.title: Aspirin in older adults: a randomized trial

METHODS: 19000 adults.
RESULTS: Fatal events were more common with aspirin (HR 1.14).
CONCLUSIONS: Harm.

study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Moderate drinking is said to protect the heart.
METHODS: 50000 adults.
RESULTS: Heart attacks were less common in moderate drinkers (HR 0.85).

study.title: Elderberry in travellers: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Elderberry is said to prevent influenza.
METHODS: 300 travellers.
RESULTS: Fewer travellers had flu-like illness (12% vs 18%).
CONCLUSIONS: Possible benefit.

study.title: Vitamin D in schoolchildren: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Influenza-like illness (ILI) is common in winter.
METHODS: 400 children.
RESULTS: ILI occurred in 10% and 14%.
CONCLUSIONS: Possible benefit.

study.title: Exercise in adults: a randomized trial

METHODS: 200 adults.
RESULTS: PHQ-9 scores fell by 3 points.
CONCLUSIONS: Exercise helped.

RESULTS: Word recall fell by 20% after a night awake.

study.title: Beetroot juice in older adults: a randomized trial
study.abstract:

study.title: Blue-light exposure from screens in young adults
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Blue light from screens is said to cause eye damage.
METHODS: 120 adults, 6 months.
RESULTS: Retinal thickness and macular pigment did not change.
CONCLUSIONS: No harm seen.

study.title: Iron supplements in pregnant women: a randomised trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Iron deficiency anemia is common in pregnancy.
METHODS: 400 women.
RESULTS: Anaemia at term was less common with iron (RR 0.6).
CONCLUSIONS: Iron prevents anaemia.

study.title: Zinc in children: a randomised trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Acute diarrhea kills many children.
METHODS: 600 children.
RESULTS: Diarrhoea lasted 12 hours less with zinc.
CONCLUSIONS: Zinc helped.

study.title: Early peanut introduction in infants: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Peanut allergy is rising.
METHODS: 640 infants.
RESULTS: Fewer children were allergic to peanut at 60 months (3% vs 17%).
CONCLUSIONS: Early introduction helped.

study.title: Prunes in adults: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Constipation is common.
METHODS: 40 constipated adults.
RESULTS: Stool frequency rose by 1.2 a week.
CONCLUSIONS: Prunes helped.

study.title: Ginger in early pregnancy: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Nausea is common in early pregnancy.
METHODS: 120 women.
RESULTS: Fewer women felt nauseated (30% vs 50%), and vomiting fell.
CONCLUSIONS: Ginger helped.

study.title: Sodium bicarbonate in older adults: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is common.
METHODS: 300 adults with CKD.
RESULTS: eGFR fell less with bicarbonate.

METHODS: 200 infants.
RESULTS: Atopic dermatitis occurred in 15% and 25%; SCORAD fell.

study.title: Peppermint oil in adults: a randomized trial

study.title: Compression stockings after surgery: a randomised trial

METHODS: 100 patients.
RESULTS: Leg oedema was less with stockings.

study.title: Fluoride varnish in children: a randomized trial
study.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Dental caries is common.
METHODS: 500 children.
RESULTS: DMFT increments were 0.8 and 1.4.
CONCLUSIONS: Varnish helped.
